description:
List the videos of a YouTube playlist in playlist order (1 credit per call).

        One page per call, with each video's position, duration and channel. To get the next
        page, call again with the `cursor` this tool returns; every page costs the same, even
        for playlists of thousands of videos. Mixes (RD...) and private playlists cannot be
        listed.

        Args:
            playlist_id: YouTube playlist ID (e.g. PLxxxxxx, or UUxxxxxx for a channel's uploads)
            limit: Number of videos to return (default 30, max 100)
            cursor: The cursor returned by the previous page, to get the next one
name: list_playlist_videos
title: List playlist videos
